**1.019: One Sabich, and one Voice detection switch.**

- **One Sabich:** the model that was Sabich (Rolling) is now just Sabich, and it is the default on Ubuntu and Windows too. Sabich (Stable) and Jachnun are no longer offered. If you were using one of them, Hebrish moves to a model you already have, or to Sabich, which downloads once.
- **Voice detection everywhere:** one switch now covers Voice Typing and Transcription Mode, in the tray and on both tabs, so skipping silence works when typing at the cursor too. It has no effect on Shakshuka with Insert as you go.
- Beta: Ubuntu 26.04 .deb. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
